{{BPFK Section from tiki|BPFK Section: Causation sumtcita|100}}
== Proposed Definitions And Examples ==

{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: ri'a (BAI) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
With cause... Tags a sumti as fitting the 1st place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is caused by the referent of the tagged sumti.

==== Proposed Tag ====
rinka modal

==== See Also ====
* {rinka}
* {ja'e}
* {ni'i}
* {mu'i}
* {ki'u}
* {se ri'a}
* {te ri'a}
* {ri'a nai}
* {se ri'a nai}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* cause
* because

==== Usage Examples ====

''.i le bolci cu farlu ri'a lo nu mi co'u sarji ri''<br>
The ball fell because I stopped holding it up.
{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: ri'a ma (BAI*) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====

With what cause? Tags a sumti question marker as fitting the first place of rinka.  Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the first place of rinka and then fills it with a sumti question cmavo (ma).  In other words, the tagged sumti asks what physically caused the event described by the bridi.  

==== Proposed Tag ====
rinka modal question

==== See Also ====
* {rinka}
* {ja'e}
* {ni'i}
* {mu'i}
* {ki'u}
* {ri'a}
* {se ri'a}
* {te ri'a}
* {ri'a nai}
* {se ri'a nai}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* With what cause?
* How?

==== Usage Examples ====
''mi na djuno lo du'u ri'a ma kau mi cortu le stedu''<br>
I don't know why my head hurts.<br>
<br>
Artificial:
''.i ri'a ma le tsani cu blanu''<br>
Why is the sky blue?
{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo: ri'a nai (BAI*) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====

Not caused by... Tags a sumti as not fitting the 1st place of rinka. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of na'e rinka and then fills it with the tagged sumti.  In other words, the event described by the bridi is not caused by the referent of the tagged sumti.

==== Proposed Tag ====
na'e rinka modal

==== See Also ====
* {rinka}
* {ja'e}
* {ni'i}
* {mu'i}
* {ki'u}
* {ri'a}
* {se ri'a}
* {te ri'a}
* {ri'a ma}
* {se ri'a nai}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* Not caused by
* Regardles of cause.

==== Usage Examples ====
''.i ma rinka lo nu .ue mi ka'e vasxu se ri'a nai lo nu mrobi'o kei sepi'o nai lo vacri lumci cabra''<br>
What caused you to be able to breathe without dying and without using an air-cleaner?<br>
<br>
Artificial:
''.i mi nelci do ri'anai lo za'i do melbi''<br>
I like you, but not because you're beautiful.

==== Notes ====

It should be noted (and this applies to all BAI+nai constructs) that while the above example asserts that "mi nelci do", and it asserts that this isn't a result of "do melbi", it does *not* assert "do melbi" one way or the other.
{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}

=== cmavo: bai (BAI) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====

Compelled by... Tags a sumti as fitting the 1st place of bapli. Augments the bridi in which it occurs, adding an extra place with the meaning of the 1st place of bapli and then fills it with the tagged sumti. In other words, the event described by the bridi is compelled by the referent of the tagged sumti.

==== Proposed Tag ====
bapli modal

==== See Also ====
* {bapli)
* {se bai}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* Compelled by...

==== Usage Examples ====
''.i za'a bai lo skami mi nalviska le se cinri nu casnu'' (Rather modified.)<br>
Apparently, the computer compels me to not see the interesting discussion.
{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}

=== cmavo: va'o (BAI) ===

In other words, the event described by the bridi occurs under the conditions described by the tagged sumti.  See also: vanbi, se va'o.

== Notes ==

== Impact ==

There exists a contradiction between the CLL and the ma'oste about the meaning of BAInai WRT causals. The interpretation we are using (explicated in the preface section) here for "ri'a nai" and such matches with that found in the CLL (Chapter 9, Section 13). To get the meaning shown in the ma'oste (despite...), it is suggested to use e.g. to'eri'anai instead of ri'anai.

This is shown as the following:

* ri'a == with cause
* ri'anai == not with cause (regardless of cause)
* to'eri'a == prevented by 
* to'eri'anai == not prevented by (despite)
